**Most likely root cause: `checkoutservice` disk I/O anomaly.** It begins at 16:23: disk I/O jumps from 0 to roughly 4.6–10.6 billion, while checkout p90 latency rises from about 0.2 to 0.4–0.5. CPU, memory, and sockets rise at the same time, but the disk I/O change is the clearest fault signal. The dependency map shows checkoutservice is called by frontend, so checkout delays can propagate to frontend requests.

The frontend metrics shown remain steady, with zero reported errors and unchanged p90; the supplied log-line table has no entries. So the telemetry points to checkoutservice as the likely source, but does not show frontend impact directly.
